stopObservation.interpretation: This is the native turn interruption receipt; it is not proof that the command stopped, and it is not an exact UI-click or ACP request-send timestamp.

limits: Only the named file and this marker-associated turn/tool records at or after the specified cutoff were inspected; unrelated message bodies, reasoning, secrets and other sessions were not extracted.
This establishes the actual command completion after the native turn interruption. It does not by itself establish when the installed UI rendered the result or whether another Agent ran concurrently.

The custom_tool_call record status completed describes that call item and was recorded before actual CommandExecution completion; the final item_completed CommandExecution record is used for tool completion.
The explicit duration includes nanoseconds; timestamps are millisecond-resolution and need not subtract to the identical duration.
Completion was already present on the first scoped read, so no further polling or Agent request was needed.
